# assignmentB2XinyueZhang

<!-- badges: start -->
<!-- badges: end -->

'assignmentB2XinyueZhang' provides the function called 'summarise_stat()', which calculate mean, median, minimum and maximum of a numeric column in a data frame, and returns them in a tibble. It works with the grouped data frame, and the user can choose whether to remove NA value or not. 

## Installation

You can install the development version of assignmentB2XinyueZhang from [GitHub](https://github.com/UBC-STAT545-F2026/assignmentB2XinyueZhang) with:

``` r
# install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_github("UBC-STAT545-F2026/assignmentB2XinyueZhang",ref="0.1.0")
```

## Usage

```{r example}
library(assignmentB2XinyueZhang)

# summary statistic for a numeric column
summarise_stat(mtcars, mpg)

# remove NA values before calculating
summarise_stat(airquality, Ozone, na.rm = TRUE)

# summarise statistic for each group
summarise_stat(dplyr::group_by(mtcars, cyl), mpg)
```
